title: Verify: Dialog wrapper unit tests
description: Unit tests for the wrapper using testing-library in jsdom.
acceptance_criteria: Given an open Dialog with title and description, then role dialog has the accessible name and description
Given a className on DialogContent, then the dialog element carries that class

steps.action: Start with // @vitest-environment jsdom. Render <Dialog open><DialogContent className='x-test'><DialogTitle>T</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>D</DialogDescription></DialogContent></Dialog>. Add three tests: getByRole('dialog') exists; the dialog has accessible name 'T' (toHaveAccessibleName) and description 'D' (toHaveAccessibleDescription); the dialog element has class x-test.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/dialogUi.test.tsx
